purpose: Compare FP16 weights with packed Q4 weights while holding tile geometry and FP16 SIMD-group matrix arithmetic constant, then compare the integrated Q4 path with the production FP16/MPS path.

isolated.correctness: All outputs exactly matched the representable synthetic reference.

shapes.caveat: FP16 maximum was a 3.8735 ms outlier; minimum-to-minimum speedup is 1.09723x.

integrated_adjacent_two_step.conclusion: Tile-local Q4 unpacking beats the otherwise identical custom FP16 kernel, but the integrated Q4 path remains slower than the production FP16 path, whose large MLP projections use MPS. Step 2 Q4 wall time is 1.436x FP16 and representative block GPU time is about 1.522x FP16.
